title: Injuries mount for Patriots' Gabe Jacas, NFL's only unsigned second-round pick

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Injuries mount for Patriots' Gabe Jacas, NFL's only unsigned second-round pick
sources.description: Every second-round pick in the 2026 NFL draft has signed his rookie contract, except one: Patriots linebacker Gabe Jacas, who remains unsigned as questions surround his non-participation in the team's offseason work.
